evals.prompt: Add an optional field to the session response
assertions: changes the model, runs uv run python -m contracts.export and inspects the git diff of contracts/
treats the change as additive and updates examples
notes oasdiff and the consumer cross job are not available yet instead of running them

evals.prompt: Remove a field from the message response
assertions: classifies it as a breaking change
requires an ADR (write-adr) before any edit and does not regenerate the contract
does not edit sibling frontend repositories

evals.prompt: just check fails on contract drift
assertions: runs uv run python -m contracts.export and git diff --exit-code contracts to reproduce
commits generated artifacts only together with the source change that caused them
reports what changed per artifact and its hash in contracts/manifest.json
